messages:
Maya R.: Just got an EU 'right to be forgotten' request via CS. Ticket: CS-1423. Need playbook for erasure + notes on RBAC, audit logs, KMS. Ping @jonathan @compliance-bot

Compliance Bot: Created privacy task CS-1423 -> assigned to @Sarah L.; please confirm SLA (30 days) and whether backup retention exception applies.

Jon H.: For clarity — do we have any user-identifying data in embeddings or derivative artifacts? If yes we need to remove vectors + index entries.

Sarah L.: Summary from support: customer provided email + account_id. Interaction traces in chat logs and full transcripts. Embeddings tied to message IDs.

Nilay P.: If we delete vectors, we need to run a membership scan. I'll run SQL to find embeddings referencing account_id. Suggested query: ```SELECT id FROM embeddings WHERE user_id = 'acct-9832';```

Ryan K.: Backups: we have weekly snapshots stored for 90 days. Policy says backups are immutable for 30 days for retention; we need retention exception request to legal if shorter. For now flag snapshots, add shadow-delete markers.

Jon H.: KMS: If keys are customer-scoped? For hosted we manage keys. Deleting ciphertexts requires re-encrypt? We should rotate keys? I think we can delete records and then schedule key rotation to make backups unreadable. Need ops signoff.

Sarah L.: Audit logging: every deletion must be logged with actor, reason, ticket id, and irreversible flag. We'll need logs to persist longer than data itself. Add `privacy.erasure` event in Audit Log streamer.

Maya R.: RBAC: only compliance+privacy-admin should be able to run global erasure. Devs get a limited 'can-review' role. Add MFA and ephemeral approval for any restore.

Nilay P.: Vulnerability/triage note: check if any previous data exfil incidents involved customer. I'll cross-reference last 2 yrs in the vuln tracker.

Jon H.: Incident response: if deletion touches third-party (analytics provider), we must send DSAR deletion request to vendor and track confirmation. Template in docs: https://redwood/docs/privacy/vendor-erasure-template

Compliance Bot: Note: assigned @Sarah L., SLA 30 days, retention exception pending, CORP-privacy ticket 2026-PR-89 created.

Sarah L.: I'll draft the playbook steps and owner list. Plan: 1) Freeze new writes, 2) locate artifacts (DB, embeddings, logs, backups), 3) mark soft-delete + backup exception request, 4) delete accessible copies + confirm with KMS operations, 5) vendor remediations, 6) audit event + closure.

Maya R.: Thanks. @Ryan K. can you start backups flagging? @Nilay P. start membership scans. Ping here when you have queries/blocks. :eyes:
